> **Severity gate:** CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM OPEN findings block delivery; LOW/INFO remain in the milestone/audit backlog. Evidence must prove real impact to accepted scope; `NOT_VERIFIED` mandatory criteria also block irrespective of severity. No optional enhancement is an acceptance defect.
